exposure: preterm trial of labor following a cesarean delivery
cohort: 4865 women attempting TOLAC after a single low segment transverse cesarean delivery
finding: VBAC rates were lower in preterm compared to term deliveries, while maternal outcomes were comparable, and neonatal outcomes were less favorable in the preterm group.
mod_finding: Vaginal birth after cesarean (VBAC) rates were lower in preterm compared to term deliveries.
